They might be asking if the seamless pants have no seams, i.e., not three seams. They want confirmation that the seamless pants do not have three seams. So we should respond confirming that the seamless pants indeed have no seams, not three seams. We can ask clarifying question: "Apakah Anda bertanya apakah celana seamless tidak memiliki tiga jahitan?" But we can answer: "Ya, celana seamless memang tidak memiliki tiga jahitan, karena dirancang tanpa jahitan." Provide confirmation.
